items.title: Investors are ignoring the biggest source of data-center water use
items.summary: How to meet the power demands of AI data centers is, in many ways, the question at the intersection of sustainability and economic growth right now.

items.title: Greenpeace threatens legal action against Crown Estate as research warns seabed fees could raise energy costs
items.summary: Greenpeace UK has threatened legal action against the Crown Estate over the way it charges offshore wind developers for access to the seabed, as new research warns the system could add billions of pounds to future electricity costs.

items.title: The A-Z of Scope 3: Defining and explaining changes to sustainability and procurement teams
items.summary: With global regulations tightening and persistent supply chain disruptions making procurement an increasingly complex challenge, managing value-chain carbon has moved to the top of the corporate agenda.

items.title: EU electricity sector calls for strengthened Emissions Trading System and pricing
items.summary: As negotiations on the European Commission's proposed review of the EU Emissions Trading System (ETS) begin this week, calls have emerged to ensure a stable and meaningful carbon price is delivered to assist with decarbonisation and electrification efforts.

items.title: TWO WEEKS LEFT to nominate for edie’s 30 Under 30 Class of 2027
items.summary: Know a young professional making an impact and driving sustainable progress in their business? Nominations for edie’s 30 Under 30 Class of 2027 close on 16 October.

items.title: NYK Takes 30% Stake in Norway’s Trudvang CCS Project
items.summary: Japanese shipping group NYK is moving deeper into Europe’s carbon capture and storage market. The company has agreed to acquire a 30% interest in Norway’s Trudvang CCS project.

items.title: Garanti BBVA Raises $125 Million to Finance Green SMEs
items.summary: Garanti BBVA has completed a $125 million sustainable subordinated bond issuance with a consortium comprising IFC and DEG.

items.title: CIF Backs Türkiye’s Industrial Decarbonization With $250 Million, Mobilizing $2.8 Billion
items.summary: Türkiye is preparing a major push to cut emissions from heavy industry, backed by $250 million in catalytic funding from the Climate Investment Funds (CIF).

items.title: NOX Energy Raises $3.4M to Build Europe’s Energy Flexibility Network
items.summary: NOX Energy has raised $3.4 million in seed funding to expand software that turns household energy equipment into flexible grid assets.

items.title: Diginex Launches Supply Chain Due Diligence Platform for $7 Billion Market
items.summary: Diginex has launched an enhanced end-to-end supply chain due diligence platform as companies face mounting pressure to identify environmental, social and compliance risks beyond their direct suppliers.
